_readme: Friendly labels for game save keys, used by the admin Game data editor.
Save formats belong to the games, not to this site — there are 216 of them
and no common convention, so nothing here is guessed. Add entries as you
identify keys: open Admin -> Game data, play a game, reload, and see which
key changed. Then name it here and it shows as a label from then on.
The editor works fine without any of this; labels are only a convenience.
